<title level="1" right="Hazard 9" pfs="">[Bestial Transformation](/Hazards.aspx?ID=413)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Acid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=3" />
<trait label="Mechanical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=105" />
<trait label="Trap" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=158" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown](/Sources.aspx?ID=210) pg. 40

**Complexity** Simple

</column>

Enchanted carvings of animals transform any creatures who damage the door into the animal they harmed.

---

**Stealth**
DC 30 (master)

**Disable**
DC 26 [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) (expert) to handle the animal carvings or DC 33 [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) (master) to scratch out the animal carvings or [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78) (5th level; [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) DC 28) to counteract the spell

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Animal Form** <actions string="Reaction" /> **Trigger** A creature damages the door; **Effect** The trap casts [_bestial curse_](/Spells.aspx?ID=670) on the triggering creature (DC 32 Fortitude save); on a critical failure, the duration is 2 hours.

---
**Reset**
automatic
